name: Simula 67
typeSystem: Static; introduced the class as a language construct combining data and procedures, together with subclassing (inheritance) and virtual procedures for what would later be called dynamic dispatch - the origin of essentially all later object-oriented type systems.
runtime: Compiled to native code, often via a generated intermediate representation; most implementations included automatic garbage collection for class objects, unusually early for a compiled systems language.

runtimes.name: Native (GNU cim, and historical UNIVAC/Burroughs compilers)
runtimes.role: AOT compiles Simula to native code; the modern open-source GNU cim implementation compiles Simula through C.

compilers.name: GNU cim
compilers.role: Modern open-source Simula compiler, translating to C.

concurrencyModel: 'Quasi-parallel' coroutines (via detach/resume/call on class objects) let one process explicitly hand control to another - a direct precursor to modern cooperative coroutines and generators.

codeExample.caption: A class with a virtual procedure, overridden in a subclass
